news.summary: Databricks released its July 2026 product update, introducing a Beta integrated CDC (Change Data Capture) pipeline for MySQL and a new Veeva Vault Connector. news.whyItMatters: [pricing change] A 20% hike across six GPU families—including scarce Blackwell capacity—raises the real cost of reserved ML training on AWS and narrows its price gap versus GPU clouds like CoreWeave and Lambda. news.whyItMatters: [product launch] Improving Terminal Bench to 82.7 and DeepSWE to 54.4 without changing the model string means buyers get silent quality gains at no migration cost—but also no version pinning, a governance risk for regulated deployments. news.whyItMatters: [product launch] Six months of free Max 20x ($1,200) targets influential OSS maintainers to seed bottom-up adoption and default tooling choices, mirroring GitHub Copilot's community playbook. news.title: Snowflake Cortex AI_TRANSCRIBE Supports M4A and MOV Files

news.whyItMatters: [product launch] Native M4A/MOV ingestion removes a pre-processing/transcode step for media, legal, and call-center transcription pipelines, undercutting standalone speech-to-text vendors (AWS Transcribe, Deepgram, Rev). Buyers with Apple-device or video-heavy workflows should benchmark Cortex accuracy/cost vs. incumbents before renewing separate transcription contracts.
